comparison.objective: Rotate a free countertop display and insert two cartons into its empty rear pockets; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires stabilizing a freely rotating rack during close-fitting box placement, not tool seating or coupled screw-and-locknut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Checks display orientation, one/two seated boxes, stability, and tip avoidance; candidate checks angular calibration, hardware retention, cycle repeatability, drift, and release clearance.
comparison.reason: The record tests placement into moving pockets, whereas the candidate tests secured adjustment and retained mechanism function.
